spans.s: Mixed with milk. -n. Possession of cattle, property consisting in herds.
ती N. of a river falling into the Indus; गोमतीमव तिष्ठति
A place abounding in herds; यो वायुना जयति गोमतीषु
N. of a Vedic मन्त्र to be repeated during expiation for killing cows;
Consisting of cattle; य उदाजन् पितरो गोमयं वसु
Defiled with cow-dung. -यः, -यम् Cow-dung. -यम् Cowdung cake; उपलशकलमेतद्भेदकं गोमयानाम्
Comp. उत्था a kind of beetle found in cow-dung
a gad-fly. -छत्रम्, -प्रियम् a mushroom, a fungus. -पायसीय-न्याय-वत् ind. (in the manner of cowdung and milky food) i. e. Very different in nature though having the same origin, Sarva.
A vaishya (चारण); योगक्षेमं च संप्रेक्ष्य गोमिनः कारयेत्करम्
गोम् [gōm], 1 P. To smear, clean with cowdung. L. D. B.
